title: Rebase, Merge, and Bounce Steering
summary: Decision dossier on the current attribution-driven hybrid: delivery requeue rounds rebase into a fresh fenced generation, while server integration preserves reviewed delivery SHAs through merge-first reconciliation. It compares delivery and integration alternatives, reconciles the AGT-2648 Batch Gate proposal with AGT-2632, documents the session-side bounce-steer loop, and recommends a deterministic backend first retry followed by a strong-model targeted retry with a two-round cap per review epoch.
